title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.5 (Peaked September 21, 2026 at 03:19 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 343 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside the Sun by volume. 🌎💫🤍

A broad coronal-hole-like region stands out in today’s solar images, while sunspot and flare-related activity otherwise appears modest.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
